name: Next Station: The Moon
source:
You wake up dead.

You find yourself at an unfamiliar, odd-looking train station, where a lazy guide and a cold but polite train conductor want to escort you to your afterlife: the moon.

A dark romance visual novel with horror elements about depression, disappointment, and two gods of death who fell in love with the one soul they were supposed to guide into oblivion.

Have fun in the seven days it takes to reach the moon.

[From [url=https://comfortkuma.itch.io/next-station-the-moon]itch.io[/url]]
